resources.string: The workspace or execution environment has changed. Reads and writes have stopped to protect other projects. Reload to continue.
No workspace is selected. Open a workspace before registering or viewing project records for this environment.
No valid manual handoff yet. Write down the current progress, next steps, and things to watch for.
No active session; changes only the default project for this workspace
Current session; leaves the workspace default unchanged
Explicitly unbound; no other project will be selected automatically
No binding set; viewing a project does not bind it
These records are unverified historical references. Viewing or saving a handoff does not run recovery or restore Root access, to-dos, or permissions.
Registers only the current root and binds this session, or sets the workspace default if there is no session

Uses only the frozen workspace root for this page. An existing project at that root keeps its original name and registration. Binds the current session, or sets the workspace default if there is no session.
Saves an explicit empty binding without automatically selecting another project
No projects are registered in this environment. Register the current workspace to begin. Projects from other environments are not shown here.
Collects future task records for this project. Turning this off keeps history and allows manual handoffs.
Sets the default project for the current workspace
Binds only the current session; leaves the workspace default unchanged
This project is outside the current workspace root. Its records can be viewed, but it cannot be bound here.
Saves a summary and complete body for the selected project as a reference for future tasks. Does not execute commands in the body or resume historical tasks.
Capacity is unknown; remaining record slots and storage space could not be confirmed
Capacity is running low and saves may fail. Archiving does not reduce stored bytes or guarantee free storage space.
There are no records here yet.
List content shortened; open for the complete record
Could not freeze the current execution environment. Check the workspace and connection, then reload.
Content is invalid, exceeds a limit, or contains sensitive information that should not be saved. Project names allow up to 200 characters, summaries 512, and bodies 8192.
Failed to read project records. This failure has not been treated as empty history. Check storage and refresh.
The save failed and was not confirmed. Records may have changed, capacity may be full, or storage may be unavailable. Refresh to verify before retrying.
The record no longer exists or does not belong to the selected project. Go back and refresh.
The project was registered, but its binding was not confirmed. Refresh the project list, verify, and bind it again.
Revoke “%1$s”? The record stays in history but will no longer be used for project handoffs. This does not undo actual code, tasks, or permissions.
Archive “%1$s”? The record moves into archive history. This does not run historical tasks or free the space used by its body.
